summary: Pass F: moves dedication/request spoken wording into four station-editable WebRequestConfig templates (webrequests/dedication_text.py), validated against a trusted placeholder allowlist, plus a local on-air spoken-length policy independent of the public site's transport limits. Formalizes existing dedication evidence (intro_track/intro_log_item/played_at/fulfilled_at) as read-only Admin fields; adds no new evidence field. Default template output is byte-identical to pre-r0056 wording.
